text:
Unwanted vegetation is sometimes placed in a bin where it decomposes. The compost formed is
used to fertilise soils.
Which gas is likely to be present in a higher percentage inside the bin than in the air outside the
bin?
A
carbon monoxide
B
methane
C
oxygen
D
sulfur dioxide
subject: Chemistry
